name: Comet Dudes
short_description: A colorful, screen-wrapping arcade space shooter for solo, local, and online multiplayer. Dodge asteroids, blast enemies, collect powerful abilities, and build a one-of-a-kind ship—alone or with questionably helpful friends.

name: The War Machine
short_description: A roguelike FPS blending arcade action with dark corporate satire. Deploy as a remote operator for Corperal, master seven characters and weapons, build synergies from 80+ items, conquer five hostile regions through endless escalating waves and regional bosses, and balance the Corperal stock ticker.

name: Tailbreak
